info.title: FloodOps application API — implementation design contract
info.description: PRD v0.5 M1 web core, deterministic bounded planner, free reports and receipt-pinned rewards. New-session schema cutover; M2 extensions are not M1 delivery.

post.description: Reset saga freezes old DO before remote initialization, persisted fixed replacement target and sealed outcome. Same reset key/digest resumes same target. Narrow replay accepts original owner credential OR exactly this reset replacement credential; supports body loss after Set-Cookie. Web verifies expected Origin and either recorded original/replacement CSRF digest; key alone never sufficient. Other old-session access denied. Return replacement only privately, no tokens in events.
Cause rain/high_tide/combined selects allowed fixture; separate road events, context alone never closes roads. Auto start planning after commit.
Only scenario-manifest fixture IDs; no arbitrary URL/provider endpoint. Context preserves units/datum/time and never synthesizes street_depth.

post.description: Fixture must carry configured authority_profile and exact superseded closure; dispatcher report review cannot create authority.

Actor from capability. Citizen always pending review. Driver quick validated path may accept low-confidence atomically; text normalization job must pass schema/map checks else needs clarification/review. Preserve accepted observation if subsequent planning fails.

post.summary: Request advisory image review for a pending report
post.description: Dispatcher-only explicit request for advisory image review. Requires a pending report and authorized normalized owned image or approved normalized fixture; accepts only an empty object and requires Idempotency-Key. No operational If-Match is required. The model cannot accept/reject reports or change operational state. The server reads one private normalized image and minimal report text; no raw media URL is returned.

post.summary: Advance explicit simulation target in bounded jobs
post.description: Target now<target<=H; event boundaries before entry/Execute. Persist advance lease, block conflicting command, query job progress. Playback visualization speed never changes physics. Persist lease nonce/expiry and committed event checkpoint. Authorized access/activation detects abandoned lease, atomically marks failed/releases lock without advancing clock. New explicit CAS advance may resume target from current boundary; late old continuation fenced.

Report.description: New-session M1 report. reward.policy is captured at receipt by the server, never caller-selected; review_result_id/reviewed_at are assigned atomically with review. Driver text uses deterministic clarification, never a model parser. No mission is required.

ReviewInput.description: Dispatcher may confirm normalized segment/vehicle/condition with reason; policy derives source/confidence/expiry from original capture and policy. Cannot make an expired capture current by review. Accept requires an unambiguous candidate; reject does not create observation.

ReportReviewResult.description: Successful manual review may update observations/knowledge with reward pending_config and award=null. It must not be blocked for absent reward config or AI advice. Full reward identity equality is additionally checked by parseM1ReviewResult.

Award.description: Committed positive simulated points only, bound to report, canonical review result, and immutable receipt policy. Amount and per-report/per-gap rule come from the pinned config; no default, pending row, retroactive policy assignment or campaign migration.

ImageReviewQualityRatings.description: Ordinal image-quality ratings under image-quality-v1. They describe visible image quality only, not authenticity, observation confidence, passability, or safety probability.

sharpness.description: 0: no readable detail; 1: blurred but partly visible; 2: relatively clear detail.

lighting.description: 0: insufficient light; 1: uneven light with some visibility; 2: enough light for visible content.

scene_visibility.description: 0: relevant road scene absent or obscured; 1: only part visible; 2: relevant scene relatively clear.

detail.description: 0: insufficient detail to assess; 1: few relevant details; 2: details support the visible-content description.

ImageReviewModelOutput.description: Strict model-only output. quality_score, recommendation, confidence, condition, points, accept/reject, and execute fields are forbidden; unknown fields are rejected.

report_match.description: Whether visible content matches the submitted description; unclear when information is missing or insufficient. It does not establish place, time, authenticity, or passability.

ImageReviewAdvice.description: Flat strict server advice schema. quality_score is derived as floor(100 * sum(quality_ratings) / 8 + 0.5); recommendation is server-derived by image-quality-v1: score<50 or match=unclear => insufficient_evidence; otherwise match=no => needs_manual_check; otherwise score>=75 => looks_consistent; otherwise needs_manual_check. Score is an ordinal image-quality rubric score, not probability, observation confidence, authenticity, or safe-road percentage. JSON shape alone does not establish score/recommendation consistency; the server must recompute both.

quality_score.description: Server-derived ordinal image-quality score, not a calibrated probability or safety percentage.

recommendation.description: Server-derived advisory only; never accepts/rejects a report or changes operational authority.

ImageReviewJobInput.description: Explicit request body must be exactly {}. Image, model, report identity, ratings, score, status, role, and threshold are server-controlled and not accepted from clients.

job.description: Null means no image-review request has been made; it is not failure or score zero.

RewardPolicyRef.description: Immutable server-owned policy pinned at report receipt. Null receipt policy is never silently replaced by a later configuration. No numeric default is defined.

ReportReward.description: M1 free-report feedback. Missing receipt policy is pending_config, not an error, award, or zero points. Manual review/knowledge may commit independently. Only committed awards appear in the points ledger.

DeterministicPlannerMetadata.description: Server-declared bounded candidate-evaluation budget and frozen configuration. Stable tie-break IDs, no LLM/tool selection and no claim of global optimum. Limit is supplied explicitly; no default numeric policy.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong current session ETag; 428 missing, 412 stale. Check idempotency replay before revision.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: 128-bit+ random key; same key+digest returns original result, different payload returns 409.
